description: Land Acquisition - Thalawakele, Nuwara eliya D/S Division, Nuwara eliya District - Maligaspe, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including orders for divesting land from state ownership and revocation of previous land acquisition orders. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and legal procedures related to land ownership transfers. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content is exclusively focused on land-related administrative actions rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
